findings.interpretation: Interface explicitly separates last-success availability from freshness/internal exposure-history convergence; no DLSS/source-transfer/persistence/resolution change inferred.
Controller independently qualifies schema1 exact fields/integer version/Boolean reset/two finite jitter numbers/nonnegative finite milliseconds; optional absent legacy evidence is not available.
Burn-in counts baseline plus distinct fresh both-eye observations and sampled CPU-frame-ID advance; successful eye-frame count remains null, no vendor convergence.
Runtime batch records observed successful per-eye inputs only on successful completion; failures invalidate evidence, not missing values filled from defaults.
Crop-sized staging texture receives source box at destination zero; source origins stored separately, corroborating crop-local sampling.
Elapsed burn-in is assessed on the loop after reply processing, not exactly last-reply timestamp minus baseline; last reply interval and subsequent assessment gap retained separately.
